title: Add a quick access feature where you can turn PowerToys on and off instantly

judgment.rationale: The requested interaction is now clear, but cross-module lifecycle and restart semantics require a product decision and a maintainer experiment.
evidence: The reporter clarified that they want one keyboard shortcut to suspend all utilities and later restore precisely the previously enabled set.
The earlier maintainer question about individual Quick Access toggles was answered; this is not an unanswered author wait.

Quick Access already exposes individual module settings through https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/blob/237dc893c8c76b1bfa65994afda41ea7315a914c/src/settings-ui/Settings.UI.Controls/QuickAccess/QuickAccessViewModel.cs.

fix_assessment.rationale: The requested interaction is now clear, but cross-module lifecycle and restart semantics require a product decision and a maintainer experiment.

proposed_fixes.title: Design reversible all-utility suspension
proposed_fixes.root_cause: A reversible global suspension state could satisfy the request without overwriting users' persisted per-module choices, but policy and lifecycle behavior need design.
plan: Confirm expected behavior for running operations, policy-managed utilities and startup while globally suspended.
Design a global suspend/resume command that snapshots or preserves the enabled set without converting disabled modules to enabled.
Test repeated toggles, settings changes during suspension, restart and policy constraints before introducing a shortcut.
verification: One shortcut suspends the active utilities and a second restores the original allowed set, leaving previously disabled utilities disabled.

reproduce.title: Inventory existing utility toggles
prerequisites: At least two enabled utilities and one disabled utility
setup: Open Quick Access and record enabled states.
steps: Toggle the enabled utilities individually off, then back on.
Check that the previously disabled utility remains disabled.
reproduce.expected_result: A proposed global command would preserve the same original enabled set without individually changing each control.
